increment: C (run-wide single-flight per immutable dependency identity) — B was worker-local reuse; A was engagement-NONE by design
statement: Increment C keeps the engagement surface unchanged — still the same AddNetwork/AddOrigins/AddDestinations calls on the unchanged public path — and adds the run-wide tier BEHIND them: all workers of one batch run coordinate through a run-scoped disk store so one decode/build per immutable identity happens per RUN, not per worker. Cross-process single-flight is ContentStore.singleflight (the dossier-06 store used by the cohort route); the batch transport is runtime-only on the trusted RowJob/RowResult payload. No dispatch change beyond what B introduced, no second entrypoint, no benchmark-only constructor, no public-API change.

run_tier.store_root: .una-batch-prepared beside the FIRST DISPATCHED row's public folder — the C30 cohort-root convention (stable across resumes, safe to delete, identity-verified at every load). Chosen by the coordinator from the plan; carried on RowJob.prepared_root; never a Settings field, never observable serial state.
run_tier.transport: the stage serializers' exact payload format — WKB geometry + .npy typed arrays, allow_pickle=False — built by the SAME pure builders the stage cache uses (_network_stage_payload / _access_points_stage_payload in Topology.py, single source). Metadata gains recorded file_sha256 + prepared:run:v1. A payload that cannot be represented without pickle (object/void uid dtypes, mixed-dimension geometries) is REFUSED at the run tier (counted tier2_refusals) and keeps only its worker-local bundle — other workers recompute it; correctness never depends on the run tier.
run_tier.coordination: flight(req) wraps the produced build: the owner builds INSIDE the lock and commits; losers exit as a counted contention_waits loser and RE-SERVE from the committed generation (re-validation still runs — the chronology law holds on every serve). An owner that commits nothing (refusal / unrepresentable) leaves waiters re-elected by the store; a dead owner's lock is stolen on pid liveness (poll-bounded — the 600 s cohort budget is a deadline, not a spin); a timeout builds unserialized with a contention_timeouts count, never silently.
run_tier.two_tier_lookup: worker-local table first (unchanged B law), then a VERIFIED store read: corruption quarantines and rebuilds (corruption_rebuilds), the recorded-digest belt refuses any generation whose metadata does not match the request digest (the content-addressed key already embeds it — the belt is the store-side truth guard). A run hit is promoted into the worker's table so its remaining rows skip the store read.

counters: cold_builds / tier2_hits / tier2_publishes / tier2_refusals / contention_waits / contention_timeouts / corruption_rebuilds / evictions / budget_refusals / promote_skips are DISTINCT counters (design 02: a hit counter alone is not engagement), folded per row via mark()/delta() slices on RowResult.prepared_stats into batch_report.extra["prepared"] with per_row slices + store_root + a notes_runtime summary. Runtime-only reporting, never observable serial state; ABSENT from extra when no row attached (paired control byte-shape preserved).

admission_and_gating.formats: .geojson ONLY (unchanged from B); feather/parquet rows are requests==0 and run the produced path
admission_and_gating.kill_switch: UNA_PREPARED=0 disables admission entirely AND the workers never attach a run store (extra["prepared"] absent, zero store writes) — the paired-control lever for the measured runs
admission_and_gating.budget: UNA_PREPARED_BUDGET_BYTES overrides the worker-local table budget (default 256 MiB). The budget is an ADMISSION law: publishes refuse at the cap floor (never partial admission); serving is never refused — a tier-2 promotion that cannot fit serves WITHOUT retaining (promote_skips)
admission_and_gating.identity: unchanged from B: closure over snapshot sha256 + producer-read params + profile + env; snap chains parent network stage; path/mtime never consulted

what_serving_changes_for_a_row.unchanged_from_B: on any served row (worker-local or run-store): the per-row file read + sha256 still run (identity law), geometry/CRS validation still runs via the produced path's own helpers (fail-closed, produced-identical errors), content-derived logs replay in produced order, and every handed-out array/GeoSeries/GeoDataFrame is a fresh copy
what_serving_changes_for_a_row.new_in_C: a row may additionally pay ONE verified store read + decode (first touch in that worker) instead of the pyogrio/arrow decode and snap sindex/line_locate_point/interpolate work; at most one worker per identity pays the full produced build per run

measured_public_claim_duty: no performance claim is filed with this increment; the 10x PUBLIC boundary measurement happens at the P05 gate under the frozen policy with paired controls (kill switch provides the prepared-off arm). The singleflight_not_lost fixture pins the CORRECTNESS claim (6 rows -> 3 builds, P00 measured singleflight_lost=31), not a speedup.
